{"problem": "你将使用如下自定义运算符来计算二重积分：

定义：f◆D = ∬_D f(x, y) dx dy。

已知 f(x,y) = -sin(2·x - 3·y)，积分区域 D 为矩形：2 ≤ x ≤ 2π/3，2 ≤ y ≤ 3。
计算 f◆D 的值。", "canonical_answer": "cos(π/6 + 9)/6 - cos(π/6 + 6)/6 + sin(2)/6 - sin(5)/6", "attempts": [{"panel": 0, "sample": 0, "answer": "(sin(2) - sin(5) + sin(4π/3 - 6) - sin(4π/3 - 9))/6", "certificate": "先对 x 积分：∫[-sin(2x-3y)]dx = (1/2)cos(2x-3y)。代入 x=2π/3 与 x=2 后再对 y∈[2,3] 积分，得 (1/6)[sin(4-3y)-sin(4π/3-3y)]|₂³ = [sin(2)-sin(5)+sin(4π/3-6)-sin(4π/3-9)]/6。"}]}
